content:
Maya (CS Lead): quick sync on HarborApps weekly health. TL;DR: token volume rising, p95 slipping, small uptick in 5xx. want mitigation steps before Thurs enablement call.

Jon (Data Eng): numbers from the pipeline this am:
- 7d tokens: 3.2M (+18% WoW)
- 30d tokens: 11.4M (+52% QoQ)
- avg throughput (dedicated): 68 req/s
- p95 latency: 320ms (was 290ms last week)
- error rate (5xx + timeouts): 0.9% (was 0.4%)

Ravi (CSM): that error jump is concerning — any route-specific hotspots? renewal in ~3wks so we should avoid surprises.

Jon (Data Eng): dug in: majority of errors come from /v1/chat/stream for long-context requests. query I ran:
```
SELECT route, count(*) cnt, p95(latency_ms) p95_ms, sum(case when status >= 500 then 1 else 0 end) errs
FROM requests
WHERE account_id = 'harborapps' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
```
Result: /v1/chat/stream = ~72% of errors, p95 ~410ms, 95% of those have seq_len > 2048.

Lina (Onboarding): HarborApps is mid-phase-2 onboarding; they're turning on a new long-context product feature which explains the seq_len shift. I have their eng ops on the calendar Thu 10am PT for calibration.

Maya (CS Lead): proposed immediate items:
1) Jon: check model-variant fallback logs + KV cache hit-rate for >2048 flows. ETA 24h.
2) Lina: update Thu invite to include latency + cost mitigation agenda. ETA today.
3) Ravi: draft renewal note with risk & committed fixes. ETA EOD.

Jon (Data Eng): early findings:
- KV cache hit-rate for seq_len >2048 = 12% (low). It looks like prompt structure changed so signatures don't match.
- cache service logged a fallback event Tue 03:12 UTC for harborapps -> model switched to quantized variant, adding ~80ms to p95.

Maya (CS Lead): ok fallback explains part of the p95 delta. Ravi we'll put that in the renewal note but frame it as resolved-in-progress.

Ravi (CSM): also watching spend — MoM spend +14% due to token growth on the new feature. customers currently ok but we should offer per-route caps and token budgeting options.

Lina (Onboarding): for Thu call I'll include:
- short cache tuning checklist for engineers
- guidance on batching/opt-out for long-context streams
- suggested per-route soft quotas to control spend during tuning

ingest-bot: metric-alert: harborapps p95 latency > 300ms (triggered 2025-11-12T03:12:10Z) :warning:

Maya (CS Lead): can someone drop a 2-line runbook snippet we can share with their engs for cache tuning?

Jon (Data Eng): sample we validated in staging:
```
# widen prompt signature window to capture variable prefixes
SET cache:prompt_window 48
# enable signature normalization heuristic
SET cache:normalize_signatures on
```
Note: requires rolling restart of cache worker (low-risk); ops coordination needed.

Ravi (CSM): I'll message their Eng lead and propose a restart window; will also suggest a temporary soft cap on the new route to limit spend while we tune.

Maya (CS Lead): I'll update the weekly account health deck with numbers + actions. please react here when tasks are confirmed.

Jon (Data Eng): will confirm fallback root cause and paste sanitized logs here when done. :white_check_mark:

Lina (Onboarding): invite updated + agenda posted. :thumbsup:

Ravi (CSM): renewal note draft in progress; will share before EOD. :writing_hand:

Maya (CS Lead): thanks all. we'll reconvene in this thread before Thu call to confirm status. :rocket:
